title: PACT Action Envelope
description: Signed envelope wrapping every tool call with identity, intent, capability, provenance, and trace context.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent run.

step_id.description: Sequential step number within the run.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent performing the action.

args_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of canonicalized tool args.

intent_hash.description: Hash of the intent contract this action is bound to.

capability_token_hash.description: Hash of the capability token authorizing this action.

influenced_by.description: Provenance labels of data that influenced this action.

uses_data.description: Provenance labels of data used by this action.

side_effect.description: Side-effect label if this action has external impact (e.g. external_write), or null.

parent_action_hash.description: Hash of the previous action in the run, or null for the first action.

agent_signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the envelope (excluding this field) by the agent's private key (base64-encoded).
